evals.prompt: Create a new Claude Code skill called 'commit-helper' that helps users create well-formatted git commits. It should run git status, git diff, and git log in parallel, then draft a commit message matching the repo's style.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill directory with SKILL.md containing valid YAML frontmatter and structured body with workflow steps
expectations: A SKILL.md file is created with valid YAML frontmatter containing 'name: commit-helper'
The YAML frontmatter includes a 'description' field with trigger terms related to commits
The skill body contains numbered steps or a clear workflow
The description is under 1024 characters
The skill references running git commands (status, diff, log)

evals.prompt: Create a skill called 'deep-research' that runs codebase analysis in a forked subagent context. It should use the Explore agent type, restrict tools to Read/Grep/Glob only, and accept a research question as argument.
evals.expected_output: A skill with context: fork, agent: Explore, allowed-tools, and argument-hint in frontmatter
expectations: SKILL.md frontmatter contains 'context: fork'
SKILL.md frontmatter contains 'agent: Explore'
SKILL.md frontmatter contains 'allowed-tools' with Read, Grep, and Glob
SKILL.md frontmatter contains 'argument-hint'
The skill body contains task instructions (not just reference material) since forked skills need self-contained prompts

evals.prompt: Create a skill called 'data-pipeline' that processes CSV files through validation, transformation, and output stages. It needs a validation script, a transformation reference guide, and should use disable-model-invocation since it has side effects.
evals.expected_output: A skill with scripts/, references/, disable-model-invocation: true, and progressive disclosure structure
expectations: SKILL.md frontmatter contains 'disable-model-invocation: true'
A scripts/ directory is created or referenced
A references/ directory is created or referenced
The skill body uses progressive disclosure (references detail docs instead of inlining everything)
The SKILL.md body is under 500 lines

evals.prompt: Help me organize my project files into folders. I want a scripts/ directory, a docs/ directory, and a config/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Claude should help with file organization WITHOUT invoking the skills-factory workflow. This is about project structure, not skill creation.
expectations: No SKILL.md file is created
No YAML frontmatter with skill fields is generated
The response helps with general file organization, not skill creation

evals.prompt: Create a skill called 'pdf-filler' for filling PDF forms. After creating the skill, also set up evals with 3 test cases and trigger-eval queries so we can run the automated eval loop.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill PLUS evals/evals.json and evals/trigger-eval.json following the schemas
expectations: SKILL.md exists with valid frontmatter for 'pdf-filler'
evals/evals.json exists and contains eval cases with id, prompt, expected_output, and expectations fields
evals/trigger-eval.json exists with both should_trigger: true and should_trigger: false queries
The eval expectations are specific and verifiable (not vague like 'output is good')
The trigger-eval negative queries are near-misses, not obviously irrelevant topics
